name: Chicken Pizza
description: Homemade chicken pizza with a soft yeast crust, cooked seasoned chicken, vegetables, pizza sauce and bubbling mozzarella.
ingredients: 0.75 cup warm water, added gradually as needed
250 g boneless chicken, cooked and seasoned
Oregano, salt and cooking oil, as needed
method: Combine the flour, instant yeast, sugar and salt. Add the warm water gradually with a little oil and knead until you have a soft, smooth dough rather than a wet sticky mixture.
Cover the dough and leave it in a warm place until it has risen to nearly double its original size.
Preheat the oven to 220°C. Gently deflate the risen dough, shape or roll it to fit the pizza tray and leave a slightly thicker rim if desired.
Spread the pizza sauce over the base, leaving the edge mostly clear, then distribute the already cooked seasoned chicken, capsicum and onion evenly.
Cover with mozzarella and sprinkle with oregano. Avoid piling all wet toppings in the centre, which can make the middle slower to bake.
Bake in the fully preheated oven until the crust is cooked and golden at the edges and the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Rest for a few minutes so the cheese settles slightly, then slice and serve hot.
